title: From job analysis to an offer
caption: Each stage builds on the one before: the job analysis sets the job description and person specification, which set the shortlisting criteria and the selection methods.
alt: Five boxes in order: job analysis, job description and person specification, advertise the role, shortlist and select, make an offer and complete checks.
description: Job analysis: what the role involves.
Job description (duties) and person specification (skills, knowledge, experience).
Advertise the role by internal promotion, job boards, agencies and other methods.
Shortlist against the person specification and select with work samples and structured interviews.
Make an offer and complete right-to-work checks.
